assumptions: The client carries no spell power coefficient on Arcane Shot; Classic's (.204, .3, then .429) is kept.

0.11 of ranged attack power on Arcane Shot and 0.035 a Serpent Sting tick, fitted to the beta's own combat logs: four level 20 hunters whose agility and gear the logs carry (Emp, Consumer, Morsmordre, Sparkz) land at 0.10-0.12 and 0.033-0.038 with Aspect of the Hawk up, Hunter's Mark and talents unknown. That they scale at all is settled by an aspect swap: Consumer (report 2673, level 20) traded Aspect of the Hawk rank 2 (14318, +35 ranged attack power in the client) for Cheetah for eight minutes on the same Wailing Caverns mobs and then went back. Arcane Shot's non-critical hits fell from 69.0 to 64.8 (0.120 +-0.011 a point) and Serpent Sting's ticks from 20.3 to 18.9 (0.041 +-0.006); against all of that run's Hawk hits, 0.100 and 0.037. The client carries no attack power share on either. Across 12 hunters in 20 public foreverlogs.gg reports (2026-09-26, level 20 dungeons), Arcane Shot's non-critical hits average 1.6-2.1x the client's base damage at every rank (rank 3: base 39, 67-82 seen) and Serpent Sting's ticks 1.4-2.0x (rank 2: base 12, 17-24 seen), from hunters with next to no spell power. One beta player reported the same (forum thread 2358919, 2026-09-23). Rechecked on 2026-10-06 at levels 24-30 with Hunter's Mark rank 2 (14323, +59 ranged attack power in the client) as the step: Miss (report 2712, level 24, 15 Beast Mastery, agility 93 and no attack power on gear in the report's own combatant info) lands Arcane Shot at 66.8 under Aspect of the Hawk and 73.2 with the Mark as well (413 non-critical hits, 0.107 a point; 0.112 from her 249 ranged attack power), and her Serpent Sting ticks at 20.1 and 22.1 (549 ticks, 0.034; 0.033 absolute). Lokronn (2695, level 25) moves 0.12 and 0.042, Consumer (2717, level 30) 0.12 and 0.034.
